marketing.title: Welcome to DoIt
marketing.description: DoIt is a task manager that makes organization simple, visual, and powerful. Get started today and take control of your tasks!

hero.title: Write the chaos. <highlight>Doit.</highlight> It turns into a plan.
hero.subtitle: Turn scattered thoughts into clear tasks. Let AI organize, prioritize, and suggest what to tackle today—so you can get back to doing what matters.

visual.label: Quick capture
visual.input: finish the pitch deck. email Sarah about the offsite. pick up the dry cleaning near the office. review Q3 numbers before Friday.

how_it_works.title: From a messy thought to a clear plan
how_it_works.subtitle: Three steps, no menus and no forms. You write, Doit does the rest.

capture.title: Capture it
capture.description: Write it exactly how it comes out—one line, ten thoughts, half a sentence. Nothing to categorize, nothing to fill in.

organize.title: Doit organizes
organize.description: Each thought becomes a task with structure: the right type, the right tags, and the links between what blocks what.

focus.title: Focus today
focus.description: Open a short, honest plan of what actually matters now—and leave the rest of the backlog for later.

features.title: Built around the way you think
features.subtitle: Capture first. Everything else happens quietly in the background.

capture.title: Quick Capture
capture.description: Free text in, structured tasks out. One thought or twenty, parsed in a single pass and filed into the right workspace.

focus.title: Daily Focus
focus.description: A short list of what matters today, chosen for you. Not a backlog you will never finish.

dependencies.title: Dependency aware
dependencies.description: Doit spots what blocks what, so you always work on the one task that moves the rest forward.

location.title: Location aware
location.description: Tasks tied to a place, with nearby suggestions and a quiet nudge the moment you are close.

resources.title: Resources in context
resources.description: Attach a file, a link or a note and ask questions about it without ever leaving the task.

modes.title: Your modes
modes.description: Dev, student, personal or freelance—the same app, reshaped around how you actually work.

workspaces.title: Isolated workspaces
workspaces.description: Projects stay apart, each with its own categories and views. Your context never leaks.

pricing.title: Simple pricing. No surprises.
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when Doit is already part of your day.
